explanation: Erdős #354: for α, β > 0 with α/β irrational, is the multiset {⌊2^s α⌋} ∪ {⌊2^t β⌋} complete? The interleaved sequence with index-distinct subsums (subseqSums') correctly models the multiset union. The site records only partial results (Hegyvári, Jiang–Ma, van Doorn). The statement is faithful and open.
